# Vanguard Society (啓睿會)

## About Us
Vanguard Society (啓睿會) is a highly authoritative and prestigious center based in Hong Kong, dedicated to nurturing gifted students and top-tier talent. Our target audience spans from early childhood to young adults (ages 0 to 18).

## Our Services
Our core mission is to provide professional educational services and organize high-level competitions designed to challenge and elevate young minds. Our key domains include:
- Medical Sciences
- Law
- Natural Sciences
- Piano and Music
- Fine Arts and Drawing

## Upcoming Event: Kindergarten On-the-Spot Drawing Competition
- **Target Group:** Kindergarten students.
- **Format:** A 1-hour on-the-spot drawing challenge.
- **Professional Judging:** Artworks will be rigorously evaluated and graded by a panel of professional judges.
- **Exhibition:** The winning masterpieces will be proudly exhibited at Times Square in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.
- **Fee:** HKD $330. (Note: No online payments are collected on the website. The fee will be collected on-site on the day of the competition).

## Contact Information
For inquiries, event details, or registration support, please reach out to us at:
- **Email:** info@vanguardsociety-edu-hk.org
